Fact: additional_assets
What to find: Other assets released with the model (training data, training code, inference or evaluation code, checkpoints) and how to access them.
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Resources, Links

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card links a technical blogpost, a technical report (GitHub PDF and Hugging Face paper page), and a release blogpost. It also gives inference code snippets for transformers, vLLM and SGLang. The base model Falcon-H1-7B-Base is linked on Hugging Face. No training data, training code or other checkpoints are stated.
quotes: For more details about the training protocol of this model, please refer to the [Falcon-H1R technical blogpost](https://falcon-lm.github.io/blog/falcon-h1r-7b) and [Technical Report](https://github.com/tiiuae/falcon-h1r/blob/main/tech_report.pdf).
Currently to use this model, you can either rely on Hugging Face `transformers`, `vLLM` or `SGLang` library.
